beats.event: Miss Taylor marries Mr Weston; Emma takes credit for the match
Emma befriends Harriet Smith and appoints herself her matchmaker
Emma persuades Harriet to refuse farmer Robert Martin's proposal
Emma steers Mr Elton toward Harriet, sure the match is working
Mr Elton proposes to Emma, not Harriet; the scheme collapses
Elton returns from Bath with a vulgar new wife; Emma is ashamed
Frank Churchill arrives at Highbury and flatters Emma
Jane Fairfax arrives; Emma grows envious and invents a Dixon rumor
A mystery piano arrives for Jane; Emma toys with loving Frank
Mrs Elton snubs Harriet at the ball; Knightley rescues her to dance
Frank saves Harriet from gypsies; Emma misreads Harriet's feelings
At Box Hill Emma insults Miss Bates; Knightley rebukes her sharply
Emma visits Miss Bates in penitence and hears Jane will be a governess
Frank's aunt dies; his secret engagement to Jane Fairfax is revealed
Emma learns Harriet loves Knightley and realises she loves him herself
Knightley proposes to Emma; she accepts, overwhelmed with happiness
Harriet accepts Robert Martin; Emma reconciles with Jane
Emma marries Knightley; they will live at Hartfield with her father
